description: A Sätteri plugin for deletion syntax (--text--), rendering <del> elements.
A Sätteri plugin for insertion syntax (++text++), rendering <ins> elements.
A Sätteri plugin for keyboard-key syntax ([[Ctrl]]), rendering <kbd> elements.
A Sätteri plugin for Discord-style spoiler syntax (||text||), rendering JavaScript-free click-to-reveal spoilers.
A Sätteri plugin that removes empty (whitespace-only) paragraphs.
A Sätteri plugin that unwraps images out of paragraphs that hold nothing else.
A Sätteri plugin that wraps headings and their content in <section> elements.
A Sätteri plugin that opts images into a JavaScript-free <dialog> lightbox with !![alt](src).
A Sätteri plugin that adds self-referential anchor links to headings with an id.
